title: Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP
text:
Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP

['From: Asha Reddy <asha@orchid.ai>\\nTo: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>\\nCc: ops@orchid.ai, Tom Garner <tom.garner@orchid.ai>\\nDate: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Partnership kickoff — high level timeline request\\n\\nHi Neha,\\n\\nThanks again for the intro call today — really excited to get Redwood into our stack. We want to make sure the first 90 days are executable and have clear acceptance criteria so our security and SRE teams can sign off. Can you send the MAP template you use and a proposed milestone timeline from kickoff to production?\\n\\nHigh level constraints from our side:\\n- Dedicated VPC + SOC2 evidence required before ingesting PII\\n- Pilot dataset availability week of July 12\\n- Production scale goals: 5k requests/day by end of Q3\\n\\nAppreciate a rough sequence (who owns what, dates, and acceptance gates). If you can include a short checklist for the security review that would help speed procurement.\\n\\nBest,\\nAsha Reddy\\nHead of Partnerships, Orchid AI\\n\\n---\\nAttachments: none\\n', "From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>\\nTo: Asha Reddy <asha@orchid.ai>\\nCc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>\\nDate: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP\\n\\nHi Asha — great speaking earlier. Attaching our standard MAP template (MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx) and the draft SOW that mirrors the pilot scope.\\n\\nQuick proposal (first pass):\\n1) Week 0 (Kickoff) — Jun 29: Align stakeholders, add SRE + security contacts to shared drive (owner: Neha). Acceptance gate: kickoff notes + stakeholder RACI\\n2) Week 2 — Jul 12: Pilot dataset handover + environment provisioned (owner: Orchid ops / Redwood infra). Acceptance gate: data access test + KMS keys exchanged\\n3) Week 4 — Jul 26: Pilot run & smoke tests (owner: Ben Carter). Acceptance gate: automated smoke test pass; latency within agreed SLOs\\n4) Week 7 — Aug 16: Security & compliance sign-off; retention policy agreed (owner: Priyom Das). Acceptance gate: SOC2 evidence checklist items provisioned + signed NDA addendum if needed\\n5) Week 12 — Sep 06: Production cutover & monitoring cadence (owner: Laura Bennett). Acceptance gate: traffic ramp to 5k req/day with no more than 2% error rate; runbook handoff complete\\n\\nOpen items for you:\\n- Confirm people who will own data handover and the primary SRE reviewer\\n- Any procurement/contract deadlines we should know about? (SOW-draft-OrchidAI.pdf attached)\\n\\nI'll loop Ben and Priyom for technical dependencies and the security checklist. If the dates above look tight we can shift the pilot by a week.\\n\\nThanks,\\nNeha Kapoor\\nSr Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference\\n\\nAttachments: MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-draft-OrchidAI.pdf (pdf)\\n", 'From: Tom Garner <tom.garner@orchid.ai>\\nTo: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>\\nCc: Asha Reddy <asha@orchid.ai>, ops@orchid.ai\\nDate: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP\\n\\nNeha — thanks for the level-set and the template. Quick clarifications from ops: \\n- We can do dataset handover week of Jul 12 but need the VPC peering details by Jul 5 to request firewall exceptions.\\n- SRE reviewer will be me (Tom) and our security lead is Priya Shah (priya.shah@orchid.ai).\\n- Procurement: we need a signed SOW by Jul 15 to hit internal quarter planning.\\n\\nI filled the MAP spreadsheet with tentative owners and dates (see attached in my reply). Also adding a short acceptance criterion request: each milestone needs a 1-line acceptance statement (example: \\"Pilot smoke test: 95% of validation prompts return responses within 800ms and no PII leakage observed\\").\\n\\nCan Ben confirm the smoke test harness and whether Redwood needs any additional sample data formats?\\n\\nThanks,\\nTom\\nDirector, Platform Ops — Orchid AI\\n\\n---\\nAttachments: MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx (updated by Orchid)\\n', "From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>\\nTo: Tom Garner <tom.garner@orchid.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>\\nCc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>\\nDate: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP\\n\\nTom / Neha — thanks for the specifics. Quick notes from the infra/engineering side: \\n- Smoke test harness: Redwood will provide a containerized harness and a sample dataset schema (JSONL) by Jul 8 (owner: Ben).\\n- VPC peering details: we'll share the peering CIDR and contact (network@redwood.com) by Jul 2; please open firewall rule request once you have CIDR.\\n- Acceptance statements: updated MAP with 1-line acceptance criteria for each milestone; pushed link to Jira ticket ORC-INT-93 for traceability.\\n\\nAlso adding risk register highlights: \\n- Risk: Pilot dataset contains PHI fields flagged late — Mitigation: data validation step during handover (owner: Orchid ops)\\n- Risk: SOC2 evidence lag — Mitigation: Redwood to provide baseline evidence pack and gap list (owner: Priyom Das)\\n\\nNeha / Priyom — can you confirm whether Redwood's baseline evidence pack is enough for Orchid's procurement team or if they need the full control mapping? I can attach a minimal pack to the MAP.\\n\\nRegards,\\nBen Carter\\nInfrastructure PM | Redwood Inference\\n\\nAttachments referenced: MAP-OrchidAI-v1.xlsx (with acceptance lines), link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ORC-INT-93\\n", 'From: Asha Reddy <asha@orchid.ai>\\nTo: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>\\nCc: Tom Garner <tom.garner@orchid.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>\\nDate: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700\\nSubject: Re: Activation runway & accountability ledger for Orchid AI MAP\\n\\nNeha / Ben — this looks good and aligns to our internal timeline. Confirming:\\n- We will open the firewall request on Jul 2 once we receive the CIDR\\n- Procurement target: sign SOW by Jul 15 (we will prioritize)\\n- Pilot dataset handover confirmed for week of Jul 12; Tom will send sample files ahead of time\\n\\nAccepted owners: Neha (stakeholder alignment & kickoff), Tom (SRE reviewer), Ben (smoke harness), Priyom (security evidence).\\n\\nNext steps:\\n1) Redwood sends CIDR and smoke harness summary by Jul 2 (Ben)\\n2) Orchid uploads pilot dataset samples to the shared drive by Jul 9 (Tom)\\n3) Sign SOW by Jul 15 (Asha / Neha)\\n\\nIf there are no objections I’ll mark the MAP as \\"Tier 1 pilot\\" and we can move to a standing weekly 30-min bridge starting Jul 6.\\n\\nThanks — looking forward to kickoff.\\n\\nBest,\\nAsha Reddy\\nHead of Partnerships, Orchid AI\\n\\n---\\nAttachments: none\\n']
